description: This file defines the LeaveEntitlementUsage class in the OrangeHRM leave plugin, representing the usage details of a leave entitlement including fields like id, number of days, days used, date range, and length days, with corresponding getters and setters.

classes.name: LeaveEntitlementUsage
classes.description: Data Transfer Object (DTO) class encapsulating leave entitlement usage details for HRM system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor to initialize leave entitlement usage with id, number of days, days used, start and end dates, and length.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the id of the leave entitlement usage.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the id of the leave entitlement usage.

methods.name: getNoOfDays
methods.description: Returns the total number of days entitlement.

methods.name: setNoOfDays
methods.description: Sets the total number of days entitlement.

methods.name: getDaysUsed
methods.description: Returns the number of days used.

methods.name: setDaysUsed
methods.description: Sets the number of days used.

methods.name: getFromDate
methods.description: Returns the start date of the leave period.

methods.name: setFromDate
methods.description: Sets the start date of the leave period.

methods.name: getToDate
methods.description: Returns the end date of the leave period.

methods.name: setToDate
methods.description: Sets the end date of the leave period.

methods.name: getLengthDays
methods.description: Returns the length of leave in days.

methods.name: setLengthDays
methods.description: Sets the length of leave in days.
